---
title: "Population pharmacokinetic analysis: model development report"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date())`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
params:
  proj_path: NULL
  final_id: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(poppkflow)
proj <- pk_open(params$proj_path)
final <- params$final_id
cfg <- proj$config
runs <- pk_runs(proj = proj)
kable <- function(x, ...) knitr::kable(x, digits = 3, ...)
```

This report was generated from the run ledger of project **`r proj$name`**.
The final model is **`r final`**.

# 1. Data

```{r data}
d <- tryCatch(pk_data(proj = proj), error = function(e) NULL)
if (is.null(d)) {
  cat("No dataset registered.")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("Dataset: %s; %d records, %d subjects; data hash %s.\n", cfg$data$file, nrow(d),
              length(unique(d[[if (is.null(cfg$data$id)) "ID" else cfg$data$id]])), attr(d, "data_hash")))
  chk <- pk_check(d, proj = proj)
  if (nrow(chk)) kable(chk) else cat("\nNo findings in the data checks.")
}
```

# 2. Model development history

```{r history}
h <- pk_history(proj = proj)
kable(h[, c("run_id", "parent_id", "stage", "description", "ofv", "dofv_parent", "n_par", "n_flags", "decision")])
```

## Lineage

```{r tree}
cat(pk_tree(proj = proj), sep = "\n")
```

## Decisions and rationale

```{r decisions}
dec <- runs[!is.na(runs$decision) & runs$decision != "pending", c("run_id", "decision", "decision_reason", "decision_by", "decision_time")]
if (nrow(dec)) kable(dec) else cat("No decisions recorded.")
```

# 3. Final model `r final`

## Model code

```{r code, comment=""}
cat(readLines(file.path(proj$path, "models", final, "model.txt")), sep = "\n")
```

## Parameter estimates

```{r params}
kable(pk_params_table(final, proj = proj)[, c("Type", "Code", "Estimate", "RSE (%)", "95% CI lower", "95% CI upper", "CV (%)", "Shrinkage (%)", "Correlation")])
```

## Diagnostics and flags

```{r diag}
dg <- pk_diagnostics(final, proj = proj)
kable(dg$summary)
if (nrow(dg$flags)) kable(dg$flags[, c("flag", "parameter", "value", "threshold", "message")]) else cat("\nNo flags.")
```

```{r gof, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
p <- tryCatch(pk_plot_gof(final, proj = proj), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(p)) print(p)
```

```{r eta, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
p <- tryCatch(pk_plot_eta(final, proj = proj), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(p)) print(p)
```

# 4. Covariate model (stepwise covariate modelling)

```{r scm}
files <- list.files(file.path(proj$path, "scm"), pattern = "^scm[0-9]+\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
if (!length(files)) {
  cat("No SCM was run.")
} else {
  for (f in files) {
    s <- readRDS(f)
    cat(sprintf("\n\nSCM %s: base %s, final %s, selected: %s\n\n", s$scm_id, s$base, s$final$run_id,
                if (length(s$selected)) paste(s$selected, collapse = ", ") else "none"))
    print(kable(s$steps[, c("Step", "Tested", "Run", "Reference", "OFV", "dOFV", "Estimate", "RSE", "covStep", "Selected")]))
  }
}
```

# 5. Model evaluation

```{r boot}
bf <- file.path(proj$path, "models", final, "eval", "bootstrap.rds")
if (file.exists(bf)) kable(pk_bootstrap_summary(final, proj = proj)) else cat("No bootstrap stored for the final model.")
```

```{r vpc, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
for (f in list.files(file.path(proj$path, "models", final, "eval"), pattern = "^vpc.*rds$", full.names = TRUE)) print(readRDS(f))
```

```{r expo}
ef <- file.path(proj$path, "models", final, "eval", "exposure.rds")
if (file.exists(ef)) kable(pk_exposure_summary(readRDS(ef))) else cat("No exposure analysis stored for the final model.")
```

# 6. Reproducibility

```{r repro}
kable(runs[runs$run_id == final, c("run_id", "est_method", "seed", "spec_hash", "data_hash", "settings_hash", "nlmixr2_version", "rxode2_version", "package_version", "r_version")])
```

# 7. Audit trail

```{r audit}
kable(pk_audit(proj = proj))
```
